item.title: Word of the Day: Fiduciary
item.description: Phonetic: /fuh-DOO-shee-air-ee/ Part of Speech: Adjective Definition Fiduciary is a formal word describing something relating to or involving trust, such as the trust between a customer and a professional. The bank’s fiduciary obligations are clearly stated in the contract.

item.title: Lady Demons host Nicholls tonight in Blackout Prather game
item.description: When a team hasn’t played at home in two weeks, what’s another five days? The Northwestern State women’s basketball team (9-9, 6-4) plays its first game in seven days after the postponement of last Saturday’s contest with East Texas A&M thanks to the winter storm affecting much of the country. item.title: NSU tennis plays home opener today
item.description: The defending Southland Conference champion Northwestern State Lady Demons tennis team finally opens play at home today, hosting Jackson State at the Jack Fisher Lady Demon Tennis Complex. First doubles are scheduled to begin at 11 a.m. The original meeting, scheduled for last weekend, was postponed due to Winter Storm Fern. item.title: Remembering Gary Stephen DeBlieux
item.description: September 1, 1950 — January 26, 2026 Gary Stephen DeBlieux passed away on January 26, 2026, at the age of 75. item.title: PODCAST: Violent Crime in Natchitoches
item.description: Join Marvin for a candid conversation about violent crime in the City of Natchitoches. This discussion highlights a growing concern in our community and urges residents, leaders, and stakeholders to come together in search of solutions.
